jobs.prompt: Create a NEW premium anatomical fitness illustration, using the supplied image ONLY for visual style, not exercise or composition. White background, realistic adult proportions, grayscale anatomical shading on exposed skin, appropriate complete opaque black athletic garments, red target-muscle emphasis. Garments must cover their entire normal area with continuous front/side/back fabric, seams and folds. Muscle regions under cloth use a soft red surface location overlay, never missing or see-through fabric. No text or labels. Consistent person, clothing, camera, equipment, scale and lighting across panels. Full objects must fit each equal panel with at least 8% white padding on every side. Adult male. Wear a complete black sleeveless sports top and mid-thigh opaque shorts. Four separate square panels in a 2 by 2 grid, 2048x2048 requested. FRONT view camera, the person faces directly toward the viewer in ALL panels. Top LEFT: standing feet hip width holding two dumbbells at sides. Top RIGHT: RIGHT leg steps forward toward viewer (on LEFT of image), knee bends about 90 degrees and LEFT knee is behind, hovering above floor. Bottom LEFT: return to standing, exact same as top-left. Bottom RIGHT: LEFT leg steps forward toward viewer (on RIGHT of image), with RIGHT leg behind. The two lunges MUST have their front knee on opposite sides of the picture, while the face always looks directly at viewer. Keep torso tall, front knee aligned over foot, both dumbbells hanging alongside hips. Red target emphasis belongs ONLY on posterior/outer rear hip fabric for glutes, not quadriceps. Render fully separate panels; no shared ground line or overlap.
